plugins.description: Nested spec→plan→work→verify→review→compound loop for disciplined AI-assisted development, plus an agent-native runtime pillar (/flywheel:process + /flywheel:run) that turns recurring domain operations into self-improving, persistence-aware process contracts Claude executes as the backend.
